original: Ballyarr Wood is a national nature reserve of approximately 74 acres located near Ramelton, County Donegal, Ireland. It is managed by the Irish National Parks & Wildlife Service, part of the Department of Arts, Heritage and the Gaeltacht.
translated: Ballyarr Wood ist ein nationales Naturschutzgebiet von etwa 74 Hektar in der Nähe von Ramelton, County Donegal, Irland. Es wird vom Irish National Parks & Wildlife Service, Teil des Department of Arts, Heritage und der Gaeltacht verwaltet.
